title: AI Music & Fashion Video (4K) – Midnight Fantasy | Disco Inspired Futuristic Deep House Visuals
description:
Step into a surreal disco dream—a shimmering world of mirror-ball helmets, cosmic fashion, and hypnotic deep house energy. “Midnight Fantasy” is a modern disco deep-house track paired with an AI-generated fashion film. I used #Midjourney to create the images. Used a cool Midjourney style ref code to get this nice disco style. I was going for a modern take on a 70's disco club anthem. Animated using #VEO3 and song made using @suno 

✨ Created, designed & animated by Kelly Boesch using AI

If you love AI art, disco, deep house, and experimental visuals — this one’s for you.

I am discovering just how technically difficult this kind of Art is.
I am an Electronics Technologist working in Telecom since July of 1979.
I build projects for clients with varying complexity.
I asked Gemini: "?can an AI autonomously create what Kelly Boesch does with the Music creation, Choreography, and then Video production directing and editing?"
(My Mother was a Dance Teacher and director of Her own Academy, and I was tasked with Music Controls at the annual Recital Concert)

The answer astounded me:
Currently, no single AI system can autonomously replicate the full creative workflow
 of a director and editor like Kelly Boesch. 
While AI tools are becoming increasingly powerful, 
they function as assistants rather than autonomous directors for several key reasons:

* Curated Creative Direction: An AI can generate images or animations, but it lacks the human intent required to maintain a specific "surreal disco dream" vision or a cohesive artistic style throughout a 3-minute-plus project.
* Manual Storytelling and Editing: The synchronization, pacing, and emotional beats in Midnight Fantasy rely on deliberate human editing decisions. An AI cannot inherently "feel" the rhythm of the music to make aesthetic choices about where to cut, which clips fit the mood best, or how to build visual momentum to match the song structure.
* Integration of Disparate Tools: The current workflow requires a human to bridge the gap between Midjourney (static imagery), VEO3 (animation), and Suno (audio). An AI agent does not currently possess the high-level project management skills to orchestrate these separate technologies into a singular, high-quality, professional-grade music video.

While we are seeing the rise of "agentic" workflows that can chain these tools together, the final creative authorship—the "directing"—remains firmly in the hands of the human creator who defines the aesthetic rules and final output.
